messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians celebrated in 2023.  
(These are the federal holidays that fall on or near a weekend, creating an extended break for most people across the country.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend/Observed Day | Typical Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|----------------------|---------------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sunday) – observed Jan 2 (Monday) | Jan 1–3 (Sun–Tue) |
| **Family Day** *(Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, PEI)* | Feb 20 (Monday) | Feb 18–20 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | Apr 7–9 (Fri–Sun) |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | May 20–22 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) – observed Jul 3 (Monday) | Jul 1–3 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | Sep 2–4 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | Oct 7–9 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Monday) | Dec 23–25 (Sat–Mon) |

> **Quick note:** Some provinces have their own “long‑weekend” holidays that aren’t nationwide (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario on March 17, St. George’s Day in BC on April 23). If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I can tailor the list accordingly!
